sections.title: Defining the 3D Cross Product
lecture_lines: 3D cross product creates a perpendicular vector.
Magnitude equals the spanned parallelogram area.
animations: Create 3D vectors i, j, k with #4682B4 (SteelBlue) and use [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/hand.svg] to highlight the coordinate axes.
Visualize orientation of the cross product vector n.
Animate n length matching area of parallelogram base and use [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/hand.svg] to trace the parallelogram area.

sections.title: Linear Transformations and Volume
lecture_lines: Cross products track spatial orientation changes.
animations: Apply linear transformation matrix to show volume change of the [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/cube.svg].

sections.title: Visual Synthesis and Summary
lecture_lines: Cross product bridges geometry and orientation.
It transforms two lines into a direction.
animations: Overlay summary text showing determinant connections using [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/globe.svg].
